plan_reference.usage: reference-only; excluded from automatic instruction discovery

truth_model.statement: This file is a PROJECTION of status, not competing truth. Authoritative execution truth lives in each product repository (mission state, evidence, git history) and in the hosting and database providers. When this file and an authoritative source disagree, the authoritative source wins and this file must be corrected.
authoritative_sources: product repository mission state.json and evidence directories
product repository .cursor/dispatch.json for hosting and database association
Vercel and Supabase dashboards for live deployment and database truth
truth_model.staleness_rule: Any last_known_status whose observed_at predates the referenced repository tip must be treated as unverified and re-checked before it informs a decision.
truth_model.ownership_rule: HQ owns business scope and writes this file. The project lead owns project execution state. Workers return results and write neither.

status_vocabulary.notes: 'not_tested' is the default; absence of a recorded result is never 'passed'. 'deployed-but-unaccepted' means a build is reachable but has not passed independent verification and owner acceptance. Deployment, verification, and acceptance are recorded independently and may disagree.
